description: This Java class provides support for passing authenticated client authorities within the AMQP protocol's OPEN frame, specifically for integration with Qpid Dispatch Router's ADDRESS-AUTHZ capability. It manages the detection of capability support, processes connection properties to include authorities, and handles client versioning for legacy support.

classes.name: AddressAuthzHelper
classes.description: Utility class for managing AMQP address authorities, including capability detection and setting connection properties to convey authorities and version information.

methods.name: isAddressAuthzCapabilitySet
methods.description: Checks if the AMQP connection has the 'ADDRESS-AUTHZ' capability advertised by the peer.

methods.name: processAddressAuthzCapability
methods.description: Processes an AMQP connection's open frame to attach authorities and version details to the connection properties, enabling authorized communication.

methods.name: isLegacyClient
methods.description: Determines if the client connection uses a legacy version of the dispatch router based on version string parsing.

methods.name: parseVersionString
methods.description: Parses a version string into an array of integers representing major, minor, and patch version numbers.

methods.name: getPermissionsFromAuthorities
methods.description: Extracts permissions from a authorities object, mapping resource-specific activities to permission strings.

methods.name: getAuthorities
methods.description: Converts a string of activity characters ('R', 'W') into an array of permission strings ('recv', 'send').
